name: delegation-policy-a-condition-loosened
why: A lead hands on an allow whose condition admits a base the delegated one does not: develop as well as main. It reads like the delegated statement, but its condition is wider, so it is not within (ADR 26-10-20-782 §11).

purposes: allow update on pull request in repository "discobox-ai/discobox" when "its base is main"
uses: allow update on pull request in repository "discobox-ai/discobox" when "its base is main or develop"
